notes: Partition verified: 21 source ids and 30 target ids each once across 22 units, one of them added.

The placement of the finite ἐστιν on the supplied are of the second predicate is the verse's open choice and is properly hedged: ἔχοντα already has have, and giving ἐστιν the are avoids both an unrepresented finite verb and an added copula. Leaving ἐστιν unrepresented and marking are added remains defensible.
The supplied but at t019 is correctly added under rules 5 and 86: no δέ stands in the verse, and rule 70 forbids joining μέν's correlation to any word other than the indeed the ASV wrote for it.
s008 ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ heads on worship under rule 66, the corpus spending worship/worshipping on the θρησκ- element (COL.2.18 in this chapter), with will rendering the ἐθελο- prefix.
s014 οὐκ keeps not as its own unit because the following τινι is a plain indefinite rendered non-negatively (any), so rules 41 and 59 do not empty it — rule 69's case.
